versions.subject: Add new rule - sysmon_delete_prefetch - AntiForensic
versions.detection:
selection:
    TargetFilename|startswith: 'C:\Windows\Prefetch\'
    TargetFilename|endswith: '.pf'
exception:
    Image: 'C:\windows\system32\svchost.exe'
    User: 'NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM'
condition: selection and not exception

versions.subject: Add french user
versions.detection:
selection:
    TargetFilename|startswith: 'C:\Windows\Prefetch\'
    TargetFilename|endswith: '.pf'
exception:
    Image: 'C:\windows\system32\svchost.exe'
    User|startswith: 
        - 'NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM'
        - 'AUTORITE NT\Sys' # French language settings
condition: selection and not exception
versions.spl: TargetFilename="C:\\Windows\\Prefetch\\*" TargetFilename="*.pf" NOT (Image="C:\\windows\\system32\\svchost.exe" User IN ("NT AUTHORITY\\SYSTEM*", "AUTORITE NT\\Sys*"))
